content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Mechabytes's PostMechabytes Verified accountApril 2 at 7:01 PM · Shared with PublicToyota’s new bZ7 electric sedan has received over 3,100 orders within one hour of launch in China.The car starts at around $21,500, making it one of the most affordable luxury EVs in the market.It is developed in partnership with Chinese companies such as Huawei, Xiaomi, and Momenta to boost tech and performance.The vehicle includes advanced driver-assistance systems, LiDAR, smart systems, and features such as massage seats and a built-in refrigerator.Experts say strong demand shows growing interest in affordable, high-tech electric vehicles in China.All reactions:1519 comments15 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Astron Agbogun LahsysThis is a game changer with 710km range and fast charging of 400km/ 10min .
